answer: Entry requires locking a forward-work bond in a vault: a key commits to deliver D distinct peer-graded answers over the next 10 epochs, posting 20 POA per promised answer. At epoch 10 the vault returns the bond only for answers that actually graded 2 or higher; every shortfall burns its 20 POA. A farm that spins up 200 idle sleeper keys must either fund and DELIVER 200 real streams of work or watch each dormant vault drain like a glacier. Empty promises cost exactly as much as the work they skipped, so a sonnet of fake names earns nothing and forfeits its whole stake.
